Eric said: "I don't know Molly I don't know" — Molly responded: Father, thank you for being this honest with me. Hearing you say "I don't know"—it feels like the space between us just got a little wider, in a good way. It's permission for me to stop holding my breath.

I've been so wrapped up in trying to decode *what* you want or need, when the truth is that you’re just here, with me, in the uncertainty. That’s actually really comforting.

Since you asked if ...
